answer: The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
